sourceEdition: 2025 colour reconstruction; Voyager 1 images from 27 February 1979, 03:55:47 to 12:52:35 UTC
projection: Simple cylindrical; planetographic latitude; System III longitude 0 at both edges and 180 at the centre

encoding.control: Development only: 3600 x 1800; linear-light Lanczos reduction, AVIF quality 90, 4:4:4

processing: Original RGB pixels retained before compressed encoding; no sharpening, generated detail, palette edits or texture reprojection.
limitations: Synthetic green and RGB reconstruction from orange/violet observations; manually blended seams and smooth missing polar data as documented by the author. Not the exact cloud pattern at the 5 March closest approach. The 7200-wide grid slightly oversamples the original observations.
